📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste text.

  3. See the verdict and any duplicate letters.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is an isogram?

An isogram is a word or phrase with no repeating letters, like 'subdermatoglyphic'. Case and spaces are ignored.

What does it show if it fails?

Each repeated letter is listed with how many times it appears.

Are spaces and punctuation ignored?

Yes — only the letters A-Z are checked, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.
